ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low. The surface is predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixel clusters concentrated on the right lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, non-parallel white linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) visible on the proximal and medial regions of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent high-intensity, textured calcareous-like clusters (barnacles) on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes; a deep, irregular indentation is visible on the right lobe's trailing edge distal to the notch.
